up: Retrieve the compound chembl_id, preferred name, exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation), and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4888487. Filter for exact activity measurements where the standard relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Join assays, activities, compound structures, and molecule dictionary. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4888487' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
